lines: A warped spring, covered in wounds
I walked on without any anesthetic
It echoes from deep inside my body
That I haven't lived enough, loud and strong
Still I savor it, the taste of gum I've finished chewing
With a heart that hasn't gone cold, still as it is
At the end of losing things one by one
What finally remained
If this isn't love, then what do you call it
I never knew
Call it out, the name of a flower, just one
Until I feel like I'll burst
Our noses touch, my breath stops
Let the pain stay, unchanged, forever
What are you trying to say with those tired eyes
I walked with my scars hidden
And yet I scattered shadows behind me
I wanted someone to notice
Can I still walk? I chewed it over, the taste of sand
On grass soaked with night dew
To my restless heart, I put the question
It's too early for this to be over, isn't it
Smiling so that no one would grieve
I couldn't manage it
One thing, just one would be enough, if only I could protect it
That would have been enough
It's so worthless, and still the wish won't fade
A soul no one can take from me
What could I compare you and me to
Matching scars left on our heels
Tie together the breaks in the clouds, and it goes on
Let's go (let's go)
Before any flowers have bloomed
If this isn't love, then what do you call it
I never knew
Call it out, the name of a flower, still afraid as you are
That it has to be you, no one else
Our noses touch, my breath stops
Let the pain stay, unchanged, forever
It's so worthless, and still the wish won't fade
It won't stop
